summary: Boeing interlude: human has last word via probes, not vibes. Single point of failure is one reviewer plus a contract that omits who consumes events; path-prefix audit would be a single bad sensor.
evidence: Did not accept compile-looking code: GET list IDOR, emit-without-subscriber, close-after-first WS were all measured before merge.
Second sensor: sequential ASGI probes (outsider 403, audit comment count, two-event WS).
Last word stays with the reviewer; AI does not override a failing probe.
